subject: POC plan & final readout scheduling — MedBase / Redwood POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@medbase.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: POC proposal + success criteria (next steps)

Hi Sara —

Great to chat today. Thanks for walking through MedBase’s evaluation priorities. Per our call, I pulled together a short POC plan (attached) and a mutual action plan to keep timelines and owners clear. Key points: 

- POC scope: inference integration for the patient triage assistant (text generation + contextual retrieval).
- Success criteria (we need confirmation): 1) 95th percentile latency < 400ms for 512-token prompts; 2) average token cost < $0.002 for production mix; 3) human-reviewed relevance >= 85% on a 200-sample eval set.
- Proposed timeline: 2-week trial (sandbox integration + 1 week of production-like load tests), final readout in week of June 22.
- Owners: MedBase engineering (Tom) for integration, Sara for exec decision; Redwood: Marcus (tech lead), Neha (security/compliance), me (PM/engagement).

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (first draft).

Can you confirm the success criteria above and that June 22 works for a final readout with your execs? Also please share any required security docs or procurement timelines so we can align.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marcus and Neha for technical details.

— Marissa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@medbase.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@medbase.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 18:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC proposal + success criteria (next steps)

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for the quick plan. High level this looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: agree on latency and relevance targets; for cost we’d prefer to validate with actual token distribution during the trial but the $0.002 target is a reasonable goal.
- Stakeholders: I’ll own the exec decision, Tom will run the integration and data prep, Priya (legal) will handle contracting.
- Security: we need the SOC2 and data handling questionnaire answered before final readout; Neha, can you send the redacted SOC2 and an example retention policy?

June 22 works for an exec readout on our side — we can block 10:00am PT. Please include a proposed agenda.

Sara
Head of Product
MedBase

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@medbase.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + owners / timeline; request to confirm final readout slot

Hi Sara + team —

Attached is Mutual-Action-Plan-v2 (mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx) with owners and a compact timeline:

Week 1 (Jun 16–22): sandbox integration, initial metric collection, security questionnaire completion.
Week 2 (Jun 23–29): production-like load tests, evaluation sampling, internal scorecard.
Final readout: Jun 22 — exec review of POC results and go/no-go decision.

Proposed agenda for the June 22 readout (30–45 min):
- 10m: Overview of POC activities & participants (Marissa)
- 10m: Tech summary & perf results (Marcus)
- 10m: Evaluation results & QA samples (Tom/MedBase)
- 5–15m: Exec decision / next steps (Sara + Priya)

Neha — will you please send the redacted SOC2 and the retention/PII handling note by EOD tomorrow so Priya can review?

Sara — please confirm the 10:00am PT slot and who from your exec/legal teams will join so we can get a calendar invite out.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + owners / timeline; request to confirm final readout slot

Quick technical notes for the thread: 

- We’ll run two benchmark scenarios during Week 2: 1) 512-token prompt steady-state, 2) production-mix burst test. I’ll own test harness and smoke the KV-cache warmup behavior.
- Evaluation plan: send 200 human-reviewed samples (Tom, please upload) and we’ll score relevance blind. Rishi — can you run cost simulation with the token distribution once we have samples?
- Contract path: if execs give go/no-go on Jun 22, we should aim to have a redline + final SOW/Order Form issued within 3 business days. Legal to Priya will reduce friction if we pre-seed standard terms.

I’ll prepare the perf slides and a short runbook for the readout.

— Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@medbase.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@medbase.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medbase.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + owners / timeline; request to confirm final readout slot

Marissa / Marcus —

10:00am PT on Jun 22 works. I’ll have Tom join for the demo and Priya from legal + our procurement lead on the final call.

Links for reference: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12345), and I’ll circulate a DocuSign when we get the go/no-go. Priya — please advise if you need any additional documents from Redwood prior to the readout.

Thanks — Sara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@medbase.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Final readout confirmed — Jun 22 10:00am PT (calendar invite attached)

Sara / team —

Thanks — calendar invite sent for Jun 22, 10:00am PT (30 min). Agenda as noted previously. Attachments for the readout: redwood_poc_plan.pdf (final), mutual-action-plan-v2.xlsx, perf-slides.pdf (internal).

Decision ask for the readout: Go/No-Go on pilot progression. If Go: Treasury & Legal will circulate DocuSign SOW for signature; Redwood will start provisioning Dedicated capacity per the MAP. If No-Go: we’ll capture feedback and propose a remediation plan or close the trial.

Look forward to the session.

Best — Marissa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
